body.title: AnchorFinder
body.summary: Implement the grandfathering anchor: the oldest add of .insrc/policy.json on the first-parent history of the tracking ref, with committer time in ISO form, known false and empty values for a shallow repository, a failed walk or no add found; a later delete and re-add never moves it.
acceptanceChecks: On a history with adoption, deletion and reintroduction the anchor is the adoption commit.
A depth-1 shallow clone gives known false with empty commit and time.
A failing git log gives known false without throwing.

tests.name: src/workflow/team/__tests__/anchor-finder.test.ts: parsing git log output picks the oldest add even after a later delete and re-add
src/workflow/team/__tests__/anchor-finder.test.ts: adoption, approval, deletion and reintroduction keeps the adoption commit on real history
src/workflow/team/__tests__/anchor-finder.test.ts: a depth-1 shallow clone gives known false and deepening gives a known anchor
